Market today: Mixed signals. Tech innovation (robotaxis, Dell's strength) provides some tailwinds, but global trade tensions (tariffs, China tech competition) and geopolitical risks (Iran) add uncertainty. This environment can create volatility, especially for your concentrated, margin-fueled tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 42.88% and flagged "SELL." SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at 38.21% and "NEW." Both carry high decay risk, amplified by margin. SMH is down 7.43%, worth watching.

Watch: Keep a close eye on SOXL and SPAL for any further downside. Also, watch QQQ for potential accumulation if it hits the scanner's entry.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged, underperforming positions while staying alert for opportunities in core tech.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting given its "SELL" status, -42.88% loss, and leveraged decay risk. Re-evaluate your stop at 200, as current price is 145.36.
SPAL: Review this new leveraged position down 38.21%. Its default stop is 21.38, current price 15.54. Leveraged ETFs on margin are a double-edged sword.
QQQ: The scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup (entry 731.34-730.61, stop 728.77). If adding to core tech, this could be an entry point, but mind your overall concentration.
